weather.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 16 at 1:41PM MST until November 18 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
weather.area: Wasatch Back; Wasatch Mountains I-80 North; Wasatch Mountains South of I-80
weather.text:
* WHAT...Snow expected. For the Wasatch Mountains, forecast snow
totals of 4 to 8 inches above 8000 feet with locally higher amounts
in excess of 12 inches for the Upper Cottonwoods. For the Wasatch
Back, 1 to 4 inches with the highest amounts for Park City and the
Ogden valley.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Wasatch Back.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Tuesday to 11 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times along mountain routes.
The hazardous conditions will impact the Tuesday evening and
Wednesday morning commutes on higher passes such as Parleys Summit.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Precipitation will begin as rain for the
Wasatch Back, transitioning to snow Tuesday evening.
weather.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For winter road conditions
from the Utah Department of Transportation, visit
http://www.udottraffic.utah.gov.

For graphical depictions of the snowfall forecast, including Official
NWS Forecast, High End Amount, and Low End Amount, visit
weather.gov/slc/winter.
